question: In the 1400 m race, John reaches the end point in 1 minute 6 seconds, while James reaches the end point in 77 seconds. By what distance does John beat James?
solution:
Given:- 

1400 m race is finished by John in 66 sec and by James in 77 sec

To find:- 

The distance by which John beats James

Formula Used:- 

Distance = Speed ​​× Time

Calculation:-

John's speed = (distance)/(time) = (1400)/(66)

James speed = (distance)/(time) = (1400)/(77)

As mentioned, John finishes the race in 66 seconds while James is taking 77 seconds,

To find out how far John beats James, we have to calculate the distance James covered in 66 seconds,

Distance covered by James in 66 seconds = Speed ​​× Time = (1400)/(77) times 66

Distance covered by James in 66 seconds = 1200 m

Distance from finish line = 1400 - 1200 = 200 m

∴ John beats James from a distance of 200 square meters.
